Question 12

The length of a curve y=f(x) is given by ∫0π/81+4sec4⁡(2x)dx. Which of the following could be an equation for this curve?

a
y=−2tan⁡(2x)
b
y=tan⁡(2x)+1
c
y=2tan2⁡(2x)−1
d
y=2sec⁡(4x)−1
e
y=4sec2⁡(2x)+1
